title: My mother said I must always be intolerant of ignorance but understanding of illiteracy. That some people, unable to go to school, were more educated
summary: My mother said I must always be intolerant of ignorance but understanding of illiteracy. That some people, unable to go to school, were more educated and more intelligent than college professors." ~ Maya Angelou #quote
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
My mother said I must always be intolerant of ignorance but understanding of illiteracy. That some people, unable to go to school, were more educated and more intelligent than college professors."
~ Maya Angelou
#quote
